marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 其實, 你不是你以為的自己 : 療癒成長的創傷, 還原靈性的美好 | Qi shi, ni bu shi ni yi wei de zi ji : liao yu cheng zhang de chuang shang, huan yuan ling xing de mei hao

The experiences we face as adults are projections of childhood memories. All anger and resentment stem from our deepest inner fears. Your emotions are not you; your feelings are not you either. They are merely temporary illusions and misguided thoughts. In this moment, allow yourself to be freed from the "prison of the mind." Release your limiting beliefs, learn to love yourself unconditionally, and heal all wounds—bring yourself home. When you're willing to let go of the fear and lack rooted in the ego, you can connect with the love and compassion of your higher self
